text:
elaine: Quick design review — roles matrix during horizontal scroll we lose context for the permission columns. Users reported confusion between "Direct" and "Inherited" markers.
ryan: I noticed that too. Proposal: sticky first column for role name + sticky header row. Keeps context when scanning. :thumbsup:
kai: Accessibility concern: when the header is sticky the keyboard focus order changes. Tab lands on header controls before the row checkbox, which is confusing for screen reader users.
design-bot: Automated accessibility check: header text contrast 3.2:1 (AA fail for normal text). Also detected missing aria-rowindex on the table rows.
elaine: Good catch. For contrast I can test #0f172a -> current is #111827; aiming for 4.5:1. Also we should add aria-rowindex and aria-colindex for deterministic announcements.
ryan: One more: on small widths the sticky column eats horizontal space. Maybe collapse the permission labels into icons with tooltips at <880px.
kai: That could work, but icons need accessible names. Use <button aria-label="Edit permissions for Role X"> instead of relying on title.
elaine: UX copy tweak: instead of the small "Invite" CTA in the toolbar, use "Add team members" (primary) and move bulk upload into a secondary menu. Fewer support tickets about people thinking invite == link share.
ryan: Agree. Also audit log nav: when you open a specific entry from the roles page, the back navigation loses scroll position. We should persist anchor in URL like /org/settings/access?focus=roles&scroll=2460.
kai: Repro steps for the bulk-invite bug:
``
1) Open People > Invite > Bulk
2) Paste newline list
3) Click Next
4) Validation error appears -> modal scrolls -> focus lands on Cancel
```
Result: keyboard users can't quickly correct the email list.
design-bot: Suggestion: on validation error call `focus()` on the first invalid input and use `aria-live="assertive"` for the error banner.
elaine: Let's try making the first invalid input focused and add `role="alert"` on the banner. Also add a tiny inline hint under the email input: "one email per line, commas allowed".
ryan: Visual ask: add a subtle divider between role column and permissions grid, 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.06). Keeps layout readable without heavy weight.
kai: Keyboard nav follow-up: ensure left/right arrow moves between permission cells, up/down moves between rows. Implement `grid` keyboard semantics with `aria-roledescription="permissions grid"`.
elaine: I've updated the Figma frames with suggested changes: https://www.figma.com/file/AbCdEf/roles-matrix-redwood?node-id=412%3A88
ryan: I'll prototype the sticky column CSS and test at different breakpoints. CSS snippet to try:
```
.role-name { position: sticky; left: 0; z-index: 3; background: var(--surface); }
.header-row { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 4; }
```
kai: For screen readers add `aria-live="polite"` for the small toast when role changes are saved. Also announce the new role state like "Editor granted for Service Team".
design-bot: Regression test note added to ticket #UI-1198: keyboard focus and contrast updates required.
elaine: Thanks — can @ryan @kai pair on a quick accessibility pass before tomorrow's UI sync? :eyes:
ryan: Yup, I'll grab 20 mins after lunch.
kai: I'll join. leaving a comment on the Figma frames with specific aria props.
elaine: Cool. Small follow-up: change button copy in bulk modal from "Proceed" -> "Validate and Continue" to be explicit.
ryan: :thumbsup: sounds good.
kai: tiny nit — audit log timestamps should read relative by default ("2h ago") with absolute on hover.
elaine: Added to backlog. Thanks everyone! :smile:
